note: Future backlog only; no modification to DGS-09 tasks or DGS-10 scenarios. No feature scheduled or implemented.

releaseBands.title: Professional editing
releaseBands.entryConditions: V0.2 release evidence and profiling; independent feature approval.

releaseBands.title: Intelligent diagramming and interoperability
releaseBands.entryConditions: Stable canonical graph and version dispatcher; V0.3 baseline or explicitly compatible subset.

releaseBands.title: Connected workspace
releaseBands.entryConditions: Approved identity/data residency/security design, operational owner and cost budget.

releaseBands.title: Collaborative platform
releaseBands.entryConditions: Stable authorized repository and sync; invariant-safe concurrency prototype.

releaseBands.title: Commercial platform
releaseBands.entryConditions: Proven adoption, legal/operational readiness and separately approved billing.

releaseBands.title: Exploratory expansion
releaseBands.entryConditions: Evidence of demand and dedicated feasibility review.

features.title: Mini-map
features.scope: Viewport and graph overview with click-to-navigate; no content mutation.
features.candidateAcceptance: Viewport navigation preserves graph and history; AC-FR-16-01 passes.

features.title: Alignment and distribution
features.scope: Align eligible siblings by edge/center; distribute at least three objects; reversible world-coordinate operation.
features.candidateAcceptance: Mixed-parent constraints, graph validity and undo; AC-FR-16-02 passes.

features.title: Additional named style presets
features.scope: Apply compatible explicit properties only; preserve semantics and status.
features.candidateAcceptance: One atomic transaction, unaffected fields retained; AC-FR-16-03 passes.

features.title: Automatic arrangement
features.scope: Explicit layout preview; evaluate ELK or alternatives; support only verified graph/group types.
features.candidateAcceptance: No graph metadata loss, valid nesting, reversible layout; all FR-17 cases pass; license review.

features.title: Additional starter templates
features.scope: Software architecture, automation workflow, org chart and mind map starter templates.
features.candidateAcceptance: Independent valid instances, save/reopen/export; all FR-18 cases pass.

features.title: Advanced connector editing
features.scope: Optional waypoints, endpoint-aware obstacle routing, label positioning; no mandatory auto-reroute on every edit.
features.candidateAcceptance: Versioned geometry; path determinism and bounded failure; editor/export parity.

features.title: Extended metadata, search and reusable styles
features.scope: Owner/provider/environment/notes; library search; user style presets; explicit portable metadata extension.
features.candidateAcceptance: Schema and migration approval, inert text, field preservation and applicable FR-19 cases.

features.title: Professional notation and icon packs
features.scope: Optional swimlanes, architecture packs and UML/BPMN-inspired shapes; no formal notation compliance claim.
features.candidateAcceptance: Approved stable IDs, upstream licenses, render/anchor/export tests and no remote asset dependency.

features.title: Presentation output and themes
features.scope: Optional transparent output, design themes and presentation view; evaluate dark UI separately from diagram style.
features.candidateAcceptance: No hidden content or contrast regression; portable appearance and independent viewer tests.

features.title: Mermaid import and export
features.scope: Support explicitly documented subset, mapping nodes/edges/styles; loss report for unsupported syntax.
features.candidateAcceptance: Untrusted syntax inert; supported roundtrip semantic equivalence; explicit unsupported-feature handling.

features.title: PDF export
features.scope: Single-page fit or paginated output with explicit paper sizes, margins and readable scaling.
features.candidateAcceptance: Viewer validation, vector fidelity where supported, no crop, page/font license review.

features.title: AI text-to-diagram
features.scope: Natural-language request produces untrusted structured draft graph, review before commit.
features.candidateAcceptance: Invalid/refused/truncated output safe; model never writes directly; user-reviewed draft and cost limits.

features.title: AI document-to-diagram
features.scope: Selected text or locally extracted supported document content, evidence links and unresolved assumptions.
features.candidateAcceptance: Explicit upload/consent, no hidden transfers, extraction fidelity and prompt-injection regression tests.

features.title: AI code-to-architecture
features.scope: Read selected source or repository snapshot, infer components and dependencies; no code execution.
features.candidateAcceptance: Separate observed vs inferred links, scope/secret filtering, provenance and review before applying.

features.title: AI-assisted editing
features.scope: Propose command batches or graph diffs for selected content; preview impact and ask user approval.
features.candidateAcceptance: Validate against current base generation; stale proposal blocked; atomic undo and no unapproved mutation.

features.title: Draw.io interoperability
features.scope: Feasibility review of limited mxGraph mappings; explicit unsupported feature reports.
features.candidateAcceptance: Bounded XML parser without external entities, no scripts/remote assets, supported roundtrip tests.

features.title: Account identity and authorization
features.scope: Optional sign-in; server-side authorization; secure account lifecycle and session handling.
features.candidateAcceptance: Ownership enforced per request; session/CSRF tests as applicable; local mode remains usable.

features.title: Cloud document repository
features.scope: Server-side validated snapshots, revision checks, owner access and export/delete controls.
features.candidateAcceptance: Cross-account isolation, atomic revision writes, backup restore and operational monitoring.

features.title: Offline-aware synchronization
features.scope: Explicit opt-in upload, durable outbox, retries, conflicts and deletion semantics; no automatic merge initially.
features.candidateAcceptance: Offline/reconnect/race tests, no resurrection or lost work, account/origin isolation.

features.title: Document version history and recovery
features.scope: Immutable revisions or checkpoints; restore creates new revision; retention policy and export.
features.candidateAcceptance: Restore drill, retention/deletion behavior, permissions and revision integrity.

features.title: Offline installation and mobile viewing
features.scope: Separate evaluation of service-worker shell, update handling and read-only responsive viewing.
features.candidateAcceptance: Offline cold-load proof if advertised; update compatibility and no misleading mobile editing promise.

features.title: Team workspaces and permissions
features.scope: Membership/invitations, owner/editor/viewer roles and controlled sharing.
features.candidateAcceptance: Authorization matrix, revocation, invite expiry and cross-tenant negative tests.

features.title: Real-time collaborative editing
features.scope: Evaluate CRDT vs server-authoritative operations; invariant-preserving concurrent transactions.
features.candidateAcceptance: Convergence under network faults plus no invalid graph, per-user undo, reconnect/revocation tests.

features.title: Comments, review and presence
features.scope: Document or node-linked comments, resolved threads and ephemeral presence.
features.candidateAcceptance: Permission checks, anchor deletion behavior, bounded presence and accessible review.

features.title: Subscriptions and entitlements
features.scope: Provider-based billing, server-side entitlements, idempotent webhook processing and cancellation.
features.candidateAcceptance: Sandbox billing lifecycle and permission tests; export/recovery after plan change; owner approval.

features.title: Organization governance and audit
features.scope: Workspace administration, content-safe audit records, retention and account deletion; SSO evaluation.
features.candidateAcceptance: Isolation, revocation and audit integrity; jurisdiction/privacy review before launch.

features.title: Production operations and scaling
features.scope: Defined SLOs, load tests, backups, restore drills, alerting and incident response.
features.candidateAcceptance: Measured load capacity and approved RPO/RTO; tested rollback, restore, privacy and cost guardrails.

features.title: Advanced whiteboard and mobile editing
features.scope: Freehand, image embedding, rotation, touch/stylus, richer canvas objects; evaluate renderer fit before commitment.
features.candidateAcceptance: Separate product scope, interaction/security tests, migrations and export compatibility.
